security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'

bundle.shortDescription: A shelf of mouse-driven fidget toys.
bundle.longDescription: Trinket is a small desktop shelf of mouse-driven fidget toys: a lava lamp, a falling-sand sandbox, a ripple pool and a pot of magnetic goo. Each one is a single file built against a tiny toy SDK, so adding your own is a short afternoon.
